heroHeadline: Afghanistan Reports 28 Fighters Killed After Crossing from Pakistan as Cross-Border Clashes Continue
heroSubtitle: Afghan authorities reported September 27 that 28 armed fighters were killed after crossing into Afghanistan from Pakistan, reversing the direction of a previously reported Pakistani-side incident and signalling continued cross-border incursions. The report follows Pakistani forces killing several Afghan Taliban fighters in the Gulistan sector of Balochistan on September 25 after an attempted border incursion, and Pakistan's September 24 airstrikes on 10 sites in Kandahar, Paktia and Khost — which Afghan officials said killed four civilians. Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid had warned of an 'appropriate response' to those strikes. Earlier, the Kohat Police Lines mosque bombing toll stood at 31 killed, with Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan claiming responsibility. No formal ceasefire or new Urumqi round has been confirmed.
